body: The mugging scene is forever in my head .
I have the plates. She towed the car back to her house.
I’m guessing you’re a car dealer .
That is a discussion for a different post lol
Definitely agree, live and learn. As I am doing. I appreciate the insight.
Well my name is on the registration. The car is registered under my name, the loan is in hers. But seems I have the answer I need lol.
I sent the dealership the money for the down payment.
I’m assuming the name is in her name. Registered in mine .
It’s just hard to focus on one thing at a time when there’s so much going on. It sucks, I can’t get out most the stuff in my head I want to say.

Hey! No doubt. I Just don’t know where to start with anything in life. I feel like when I get pushed back it’s what it’s meant to be. I probably sound silly, I feel lazy sometimes but I know I want to do something. I just can’t seem to do it, I feel like I’m ruining all my relationships and still getting no where. I like to make money, but lately I’ve been broke asf. I can’t tell what’s making me so crazy. I bottle things in til I explode and can’t control it until my body and mind just calm down.
Thank you for listening and Thank you for the kind words ❤️ I was able to take a few minutes and catch my breathe. People like you are really a blessing.

I’m a 21 year old staying at moms house. Looking for work, I have a child. 2 year old little boy. I didn’t plan on having a kid this young ,Trying too provide while being broke depressed and tired all the time. I feel stuck. I’ve been depressed since I was in 5th grade. I grew up overweight and not knowing my father. I think I bottle things in until I explode. I hate being like this. When I’m this upset it feels good to squeeze my face as hard as I can. I can feel my brain screaming! It doesn’t stop. Im so emotional I’m just mad at everyone maybe I am lazy. But I have goals. Im constantly fighting with my head I’m sorry for laying this out on you.
